data.one_liner: Pure Dart SDK wrapped around the Algolia REST API for search implementation
data.what_it_does: Provides a client wrapper for the Algolia REST API, allowing Flutter and Dart applications to query indices, manage objects, configure index settings, and push insights events.
use_when: You need to integrate Algolia search functionality into your Flutter or Dart app.
You want to manage records, settings, and insights directly via an unofficial Dart SDK.
avoid_when: You require an official, first-party Algolia SDK with guaranteed support from Algolia.
You are not using Algolia as your search backend.
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of Algolia search parameters and settings.
Includes retry strategies for high availability on read and write actions.
data.setup_notes: Initialize static Algolia once in your project with your application ID and API key.
